Honorable Members of the National Assembly,
(18:38 hrs.)
Chairperson: - Honorable Members,
Now, I would like to provide time to the Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle to table the report on the Annual Financial Statement of Revenue and Expenditure for the Fiscal Year 2083/084.
Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle: - Honorable Chairperson,
(18:39 hrs.)
With the permission of the Honorable Chairperson, I table before this respected assembly the report on the Annual Financial Statement of Revenue and Expenditure for the Fiscal Year 2083/084.
Thank you.
Honorable Chairperson: - Honorable Members, the next meeting of the National Assembly will be held on Sunday, Jestha 17, 2083 at 11:15 AM. This meeting is adjourned.
(Thereafter, the next meeting will be held on Sunday, Jestha 17, 2083 at 11:15 AM, and this meeting is adjourned.)

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: The Chairperson announced the commencement of the meeting and invited the Finance Minister to present the annual financial statement report. The meeting began at 18:38 hrs.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle presented the report on the Annual Financial Statement of Revenue and Expenditure for the Fiscal Year 2083/084 to the assembly. He thanked the assembly after presenting the report.

sections.name: Adjournment
sections.summary_en: The Chairperson announced that the next meeting would be held on Sunday, Jestha 17, 2083, at 11:15 AM and adjourned the current meeting. The meeting was adjourned at 18:39 hrs.
